title: Sicherheits-, Datenschutz- und Betriebsgrundlage
description: As a reviewer, I want the security and privacy baseline to be enforced automatically, so that no release can weaken it.

acceptance_criteria.given: the application is built and deployed into the review environment
acceptance_criteria.then: the report lists no finding rated Critical or High
and: the scan covers authentication, authorisation, injection, XSS, secrets, dependencies and the container image
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-034-security-baseline.feature: The security scan reports no critical or high finding

acceptance_criteria.given: the repository and the built image are present
acceptance_criteria.when: the secret scan runs over both
acceptance_criteria.then: the scan finds no credential, token or private key
and: the scan is part of the pipeline and fails the build on a hit
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-034-security-baseline.feature: No secret is committed to the repository or baked into the image

acceptance_criteria.when: a client sends a request with an invalid field type, an unknown enumeration value and an oversized body
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 400 or 422 and a field level error
and: no unvalidated value reaches the domain logic
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-034-security-baseline.feature: Malformed input is rejected at the boundary

acceptance_criteria.given: the application is reachable over the public endpoint
acceptance_criteria.then: the response carries HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options and X-Frame-Options DENY plus a restrictive content security policy
and: plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS and the certificate is valid
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-034-security-baseline.feature: Transport and response headers are hardened

acceptance_criteria.given: the application starts with a configured environment
acceptance_criteria.when: the configuration is inspected at runtime
acceptance_criteria.then: every secret is resolved from an environment variable or a mounted secret
and: no secret value appears in the source tree, the image layers or the effective configuration dump
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-034-security-baseline.feature: Secrets are read from the environment only

acceptance_criteria.given: a refresh token has been issued and the platform runs in the target region
acceptance_criteria.when: the token storage and the deployment configuration are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: the stored value is a hash that cannot be replayed and the deployment region is europe-west3
and: the AI provider is configured without training and without durable storage
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-034-security-baseline.feature: Refresh tokens are stored hashed and data stays in the EU
